channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Collin Morikawa birdies last to end 28-month drought at Pebble Beach
item.description: Collin Morikawa had gone 28 months since his last win, and he was reminded Sunday at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-am why it’s never easy.

item.title: Where does Anthony Kim stand in the Official World Golf Ranking after LIV win?
item.description: Anthony Kim has moved up from No. 847 to No. 203 on the Official World Golf Ranking after his win at LIV Golf Adelaide.

item.title: Kim's win the best thing that could happen for LIV?
item.description: Was Anthony Kim's win at LIV Adelaide the best thing that could happen for the circuit? Rex Hoggard and Ryan Lavner discus in the Golf Channel Podcast with Rex & Lav.

item.title: Genesis Invitational 2026: Odds, favorites for signature event at Riviera
item.description: Scottie Scheffler and the PGA Tour return to Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, California, for the second signature event of the season. Who do oddsmakers expect to win the 100th edition of the event?

item.title: Penske Performance: Morikawa's iron game dominates Pebble
item.description: Collin Morikawa led the field in SG: Approach at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, which led to his first victory in more than two years. See the numbers in this Penske Performance recap.

item.title: Is Pebble Beach too easy for pros? Maybe a schedule change?
item.description: Collin Morikawa won the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am with a 22 under total. One noted instructor believes Pebble Beach might be too easy for the pros. The "Golf Today" team discusses.

item.title: PGA Tour wants to 'own the summer'; what does that mean?
item.description: The PGA Tour is looking for a way to take advantage of bigger markets and the summer schedule. The "Golf Today" team weighs in on what the Tour is eyeing and changes that could be coming.

item.title: Thitikul heading home; Hull adding to new trophy room
item.description: Jeeno Thitikul is competing this week in the Honda LPGA Thailand, her home country. Charley Hull, meanwhile, won last week in Saudi Arabia to add to her new trophy case. Beth Ann Nichols joins "Golf Today" with some LPGA news and notes.

item.title: TGR Foundation 'changes the world,' says proud Tiger
item.description: The TGR Foundation is celebrating its 30th anniversary this year. A proud Tiger Woods says the foundation is literally "changing the world," more so than anything he could do on the course.

item.title: As it returns to Riviera, PGA Tour ups ante toward wildfire-relief initiative
item.description: As part of its California Rises initiative, the Tour is re-launching its Birdies for Good campaign this week at Riviera.
